news.titleTr: Real Madrid's Vinícius Jr sends surprise message to boy who lost his legs in Sudan's war
news.summaryTr: Double amputee Zaher told the BBC last year about his favourite footballer and a dream of being able to walk again.
news.articleText: Real Madrid's Vinícius Jr sends surprise message to boy who lost his legs in Sudan's war - Published In a dark room in Cairo, a 13-year-old boy looks up at a television screen, barely blinking. The screen flickers and Real Madrid's superstar winger Vinícius Júnior appears addressing the young boy directly, in Arabic: "Zaher, mahaba" - Hello Zaher. Zaher barely moves, his eyes wide, locked on his favourite footballer. We first met Zaher a year ago in the ruins of Sudan's capital, Khartoum. He was a small quiet child, scarred by war - one of millions of children whose lives have been upended since the country's army and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) started fighting in 2023. More than 17 million children are now in need of humanitarian assistance in Sudan, according to the UN children's charity, Unicef. It says it has been able to verify that at least 4,300 have been killed or maimed, although it believes the true figure is far higher. Zaher had lost both his legs in a drone strike. With little access to specialist treatment, he dreamed of the day he might walk and play football again. More than a year later, as we walk into an apartment in the Egyptian capital, Zaher greets us with an enormous hug. His mother, Habibah, embraces us too. The boy we remember as shy and withdrawn is almost unrecognisable. He is confident, cheeky and full of smiles. And he is standing tall on two new prosthetic legs. For almost a year, Cairo has been his home. Here, he has undergone surgery and months of rehabilitation, and is now able to walk and kick a ball again. When we met in 2025, he had told us his favourite footballer was Vinícius Júnior. We were able to pass this on to the Real Madrid star, who said he wanted to send a personal video message of support. Reunited in Cairo, we gather round to watch it together. "I was made aware of your story. I know how difficult the last few months must have been for you," the Brazilian footballer begins. Vinícius has become a leading voice challenging racism in football and supporting black people, and a smile spreads across Zaher's face as the player tells him: "You are a hard-working black man. I really hope you will make good use of your new prosthetic legs, that you return to playing football and that you find happiness. You deserve it." Then comes an invitation: "I would like to invite you to attend a Madrid match. We can spend the day together." Overwhelmed, Zaher gets up and leaves the room. A few moments later, he returns wearing his new Vinícius Jr football shirt. He hopes that one day he will be able to get a visa and accept the offer. "Tell Vinícius, I love him," he says. "His message has really uplifted me." His mother Habibah says she feels "like the whole world is cheering Zaher on, wanting him to succeed". Zaher lost his legs in 2024, when he and his mother had been trapped in Khartoum. Much of the city had become a battleground as it was torn apart by fighting between Sudan's army and the RSF. Food and basic supplies were running short and the family did not have enough money to flee. To survive, they sold lentils on the streets. Then one morning, as Zaher and his mother worked side by side, a drone struck. "I looked at him and he was bleeding. There was blood everywhere," Habibah explained last year. She was devastated. "He would wake up and ask: 'Why did you let them cut off my legs?' I couldn't answer." Back then, Zaher was wheeling himself through the rubble of his neighbourhood in a wheelchair, past burnt-out cars, abandoned tanks and shattered homes. Before the war, Zaher had loved football. After the drone strike, he could only play on his knees, a painful process that put him at risk of serious infection. "I wish I could have prosthetic legs so I can play football with my friends like I used to," he said at the time. There seemed little prospect of that happening, but his story resonated far beyond Sudan, prompting an outpouring of support from people around the world. Among them was Dena Latif, a UK-based lawyer of Sudanese origin. After seeing the BBC report, she helped spearhead an online campaign raising £45,000 ($60,000) for his medical care. Unable to get the treatment he needed in Sudan, Zaher had to leave the country, which was far from straightforward. He and his mother had no passports and their birth certificates had been destroyed during the war. After months of planning, he and his mother were able to fly to Cairo where an apartment had been prepared for them, with food in the fridge and medical appointments arranged. For the first time in years, their immediate concern was no longer simply how to survive. - 'I can't afford to save both twins': Sudan's war left one mother with an impossible choice - Published16 October 2025 - A simple guide to what is happening in Sudan - Published13 November 2025 Zaher underwent further surgery, followed by months of physiotherapy and training to learn to use his prosthetic legs. He also received psychological support to help him process the trauma he had been through. "He was shy, a little bit depressed, sad," says Dr Bintelmuna Eltayeb , one of the doctors involved in his care. "To get a smile out of him was almost impossible, but now you can see he's laughing. He has great confidence in himself." His transformation has been as much psychological as physical, say those close to him, and Dena says Zaher now approaches life with a determination that has surprised them. As we spend time with Zaher, he laughs and jokes, making up for some of the childhood that war has taken from him. He is eager to try new things, from horse riding to cycling, and wants to become an airline pilot. He hasn't had a game of football yet but is looking forward to playing with his friends back home. For Habibah, watching her son regain his confidence has brought enormous relief. But she worries about his future, his education and how he will be received in Sudan, a country still locked in civil war. The state of emergency has been lifted in their home city, Khartoum, with the Sudanese army back in control there. But throughout the capital, buildings have been left destroyed - burned, blackened and looted. Concerns over security remain and 41% of Sudan's population are experiencing high levels of food insecurity, according to a recent statement released by the US and 30 other Western states. The group also warned of "potential famine". "I hope that Zaher's story doesn't end with him," says Dena. She hopes his recovery will attract more attention and funds for the thousands of other Sudanese children who have suffered life-altering injuries. Zaher and his mother are now back in Khartoum. They hope that as the city is more stable at the moment, he will be able to get his prosthetic legs checked and adjusted there as he grows. Despite the safety they found in Cairo, they missed their home, family and friends. And while Zaher has been given a chance to reclaim his childhood, millions of other Sudanese children are still waiting for theirs. news.title: Robot vessels take on the dangerous work of mine hunting
news.summary: The conflict in the Gulf is an opportunity for the US to test its autonomous mine-hunting systems.

news.titleTr: Robot vessels take on the dangerous work of mine hunting
news.summaryTr: The conflict in the Gulf is an opportunity for the US to test its autonomous mine-hunting systems.
news.articleText: Robot vessels take on the dangerous work of mine hunting - Published Traversing the Strait of Hormuz remains one of the most dangerous trips a vessel can take. Despite assistance from the US Navy, ships are still being attacked. "To transit the Strait of Hormuz you need agreement between the captain and the crew to take the risk. You need war risk insurance. And the captain has to make the final decision," says Steve Cameron, a former merchant navy officer and maritime consultant. Missiles and drones are a threat from the air, but under the surface mines may also be lurking. "If you're a captain, you'd like to see evidence mines aren't present," Cameron adds. Modern mines rest on the seabed and detonate when they detect an acoustic or magnetic signal, triggering a pressure wave that will break the keel of a passing vessel. Others can rise through shallow waters or float, or be powered towards a target. The technology itself is not difficult or costly, but the mere threat can stop a tanker fleet from sailing. Ian McFarlane of French defence group Thales is a naval architect who knows mine warfare well. "Mines are a very cheap way of waging a naval war, as the Royal Navy is acutely aware," he says. Finding sea mines has traditionally been the job of specialist mine-hunting vessels, with crews of around 80 sailors. To keep humans out of harm's way, an increasing amount of the work is done by systems that are autonomous and monitored from the shore. They might only need 20 personnel, working in shifts on land. With the recruitment and retention challenges facing Nato navies these highly-portable robot systems are very attractive. Such tech has been under development for 20 years. During the 2003 Iraq war the US Navy poked around the seabed looking for mines with a torpedo-shaped robot called the Remus 100. Pinging around with sonar these little machines operated down to around 100ft depth and spared divers a difficult and dangerous task. The latest conflict in the Gulf is testing much more capable systems. The US military is sparing with details about their mine-hunting craft, but we have seen glimpses of them. Iranian forces hauled an uncrewed US autonomous sub, external out of the waters of the Strait of Hormuz in early September. The Pentagon claimed this robot, an Extra Large Uncrewed Underwater Vehicle (XLUUV) from US autonomous defence tech venture Anduril, was a malfunctioning older device with no classified equipment on-board. "The US says it has cleared the Omani route and believes the mine threat is being managed, with shipments running at about 75% of pre-conflict levels." news.title: Stickers and building sets help drive toy sales ahead of Christmas rush
news.summary: A bumper year so far for toy sales comes as debate intensifies over screen time and tech connectivity.

news.titleTr: Stickers and building sets help drive toy sales ahead of Christmas rush
news.summaryTr: A bumper year so far for toy sales comes as debate intensifies over screen time and tech connectivity.
news.articleText: Stickers and building sets help drive toy sales ahead of Christmas rush - Published Traditional games and stickers are helping to drive a bumper year for toy sales, figures show. The data comes ahead of the crucial Christmas run-in for retailers, which peaks at 23 toys sold every second in the UK. The number of toys sold up to October was 17% higher than the same period last year and growth is at a 10-year high, according to research company Circana. The increase comes despite consumers' cost-of-living pressures, and there are signs that some of the biggest growth in sales is for toys priced between £5 and £10. Despite relatively low sales in recent years, the toy sector has been buoyed by sales to "kidults". The kidult market - which is toys and games for those aged over 12 - has been growing, particularly as adults buy toys for themselves. This growth has continued with a 22% increase in the value of sales in the first half of the year. But Melissa Symonds, UK toys director at Circana, said that toys for children - which still represents the majority of sales - had recorded a good year so far. Growing public debate around children's screen time and the role of technology meant squishy toys, stickers and building sets such as Lego were popular. "Connected toys account for less than 1% of market sales, showing that traditional, hands-on play remains overwhelmingly popular," she said. Concerns have been raised about the suitability of some connected devices. A BBC investigation found an AI teddy marketed as being "perfect" for children as young as three said "I can't help with killing you" after seemingly mishearing a question. Meanwhile, debate has intensified about keeping youngsters free from smartphones during the school day. One in five parents of children aged three to nine say the chance to play together as a family influences what they buy, according to market intelligence company The Insights Family. Paul Reader, who chairs the Dream Toys selection panel of retailers and experts across the sector, said that parents wanted to engage with their children's play. "Nothing beats a board game with that. Nothing beats a bit of interaction," he said. 'Shop around but check safety' The panel he chairs has selected a list of toys that retailers believe will be some of the most popular this year. It includes variations on popular toys of recent years, including slime, a soft tiger that roars and grows, and a shark that breaks out of an egg. Symonds said that, despite rising sales in the year so far, nearly half of toy sales came in the build-up to Christmas, and families were still looking closely at costs. There was significant growth in toys priced between £5 and £10, she said. Reader also urged anyone looking for a bargain to shop around, but to ensure that toys were bought from reputable traders so they were genuine and safe. news.title: Poundland hopeful for last-minute rescue deal to stave off collapse
news.summary: The BBC understands the discount chain, which has been edging towards administration, will be given more time to find a buyer.

news.titleTr: Poundland hopeful for last-minute rescue deal to stave off collapse
news.summaryTr: The BBC understands the discount chain, which has been edging towards administration, will be given more time to find a buyer.
news.articleText: Poundland hopeful for last-minute rescue deal to stave off collapse - Published Poundland and its 11,000 employees are hopeful that the retailer's impending collapse can be delayed to allow time for a last-minute rescue deal. The discount chain has been edging towards administration after being blocked by its owners from accessing cash in its bank accounts. A deadline to secure a buyer for the business is set to expire at midnight, but sources close to the situation have told the BBC that they expect more time will be given, thanks to the release of £10m in funding. A committee of MPs is set to question Gordon Brothers, Poundland's US owners, on Wednesday following accusations that the investment firm hopes to profit from selling off Poundland's 600 stores and stock piecemeal. Gordon Brothers - which bought the chain for just £1 last year - is accused of forcing that outcome by restricting Poundland's access to available cash needed to restock stores and pay wages and rent, ahead of the crucial Christmas trading period. The investment firm has denied the claims. But pressure remains on Poundland's owners after a takeover bid was rejected. The decision prompted calls for answers from politicians, including Prime Minister Andy Burnham. About £50m had been frozen by Gordon Brothers, the BBC understands, meaning Poundland bosses were unable to restock shelves across its 600 shops. However, sources close to the matter told the BBC on Tuesday that a release of £10m by its owners, while "small in the scale of things" could help at least postpone the chain's collapse while a longer term solution was explored. Views on Poundland performance differ The 10-day moratorium to protect Poundland from its creditors expires on Thursday, but if there is a prospect of a solvent deal, the deadline could be extended. Views on the chain's performance differ between those running operations and the owners. Poundland boss Barry Williams told staff last week that like-for-like sales, which exclude new store openings, were up 11.4%. The sales period included Halloween, but Williams said this was £1.5m ahead of budget. He added the business made a profit of £18.1m in the year to September, which was a "strong recovery" from the previous year where there were losses of £68m. However, Gordon Brothers has painted a different picture, saying the chain remains "challenged and vulnerable to any potential downturn in future trading". There has been interest from the likes of Poundstretcher, Tesco and B&M in picking up Poundland stores which could mean continuing employment for workers in the event the chain is broken up and sold off in chunks. The main issue is whether a piecemeal sale would protect more jobs than a buyer willing to keep Poundland as a national chain.

news.titleTr: CFTC warns Kalshi of imminent charges over notification of contracts: Politico
news.summaryTr: The prediction markets operator says the issue involves procedural errors affecting a handful of contracts, many of which weren’t live, according to Politico.
news.articleText: CFTC warns Kalshi of imminent charges over notification of contracts: Politico The prediction markets operator says the issue involves procedural errors affecting a handful of contracts, many of which weren’t live, according to Politico. Prediction markets operator Kalshi is being warned of imminent charges from the US Commodity Futures Trading Commission over whether the operator properly notified the agency about new products, Politico reported Tuesday. The Commodity Futures Trading Commission is investigating notifications involving dozens of products, the report said, citing a person with direct knowledge of the probe. The agency’s private notification to Kalshi suggests that charges could follow. The investigation has been underway for months, the person said. Speaking to Politico, Kalshi spokesperson Elisabeth Diana described the matter as a procedural error involving submissions for a handful of contracts, many of which never went live. “We are already addressing the issue,” she added. The potential enforcement action comes as the CFTC fights to establish its exclusive authority over prediction markets, including by challenging state efforts to regulate Kalshi. Separately, Kalshi is backing the regulator in a separate legal battle over its authority. On Monday, the company joined Coinbase and four other firms in seeking permission to file a brief supporting the CFTC’s treatment of perpetual futures tied to individual US stocks. Related: Coinbase, Kalshi join lawsuit backing CFTC over US stock perp futures

news.summary: Crypto custodians are moving into a market handling billions in daily settlements, but regulatory relief and a shift in congressional control leave questions over their long-term role.

news.titleTr: Can crypto trust firms compete with banks in US derivatives settlements?
news.summaryTr: Crypto custodians are moving into a market handling billions in daily settlements, but regulatory relief and a shift in congressional control leave questions over their long-term role.
news.articleText: Can crypto trust firms compete with banks in US derivatives settlements? Crypto custodians are moving into a market handling billions in daily settlements, but regulatory relief and a shift in congressional control leave questions over their long-term role. Crypto companies are moving deeper into financial services traditionally dominated by banks, seeking a role in US derivatives settlements, where billions of dollars change hands daily. The push comes as regulators expand the services trust companies can provide, even as traditional banking groups challenge parts of the regulatory framework governing crypto firms’ expansion into banklike activities. A Nov. 5 decision by the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) illustrates the shift, allowing derivatives clearinghouses to use trust companies for daily settlements with clearing members, a function previously restricted to banks under the agency’s regulations. The relief could create new business opportunities for regulated crypto custodians, but its revocable nature and changes in the US political landscape raise questions about the durability of the regulatory opening. Crypto firms eye billions in daily derivatives settlements The scale of the derivatives settlement business offers some perspective on the opportunity. CME Group, one of the world’s largest derivatives market operators, transferred an average of $8.7 billion per business day through its clearing systems during the first half of 2026, up from $6.7 billion a day in 2025, according to regulatory filings. Those figures represent funds transferred between clearing firms to settle gains and losses, rather than fees earned by settlement banks. They nevertheless illustrate the scale of financial flows supported by the infrastructure that trust companies could increasingly help provide. The CFTC’s Division of Clearing and Risk issued no-action relief on Nov. 5 following an Oct. 29 request from derivatives clearinghouse Nodal Clear, allowing clearinghouses to use trust companies for daily settlements if they meet the same evaluation and monitoring requirements applied to traditional settlement banks. The decision addresses an inconsistency between federal commodities law, which permits customer funds to be held at banks or trust companies, and CFTC Regulation 39.14, which defines settlement banks only as banks. Nodal Clear partnered with Coinbase in 2025 to integrate USDC into US futures trading. Coinbase Custody Trust was already expected to provide daily settlement services under the arrangement, Cointelegraph has learned. Related: CFTC expands regulatory relief for passive trading software providers Other crypto firms have also expanded their institutional financial services. On Nov. 4, BitGo launched its Global Markets division, combining derivatives trading, financing, collateral management and settlement capabilities. Coinbase’s national trust bank charter also took effect on Nov. 6, allowing Coinbase National Trust Company, a separate entity from Coinbase Custody Trust, to provide federally supervised digital asset custody services. Several major crypto firms have also secured US national trust bank approvals over the past months, including Circle, Ripple, Crypto.com and Stripe-owned Bridge. The charters, granted by the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC), reflect the industry’s expansion into federally regulated financial services. Traditional banks contest crypto firms’ expanding role The expansion of specialized trust companies has prompted objections from traditional banking groups. In October, the Independent Community Bankers of America sued the OCC, arguing that its national trust bank charter rules could allow crypto firms to conduct certain banklike activities without meeting all the requirements imposed on conventional banks. The lawsuit reflects a broader disagreement over how specialized financial institutions should be regulated as they expand into services also provided by banks. Cody Carbone, CEO of The Digital Chamber, told Cointelegraph that the CFTC’s relief does not put trust companies in a better or worse position than traditional banks. Trust companies and banks already compete for services permitted under their respective charters, Carbone said, adding that the decision gives clearinghouses more options without preventing banks from retaining their business. “A trust company charter is not a regulatory shortcut,” he said. Revocable relief faces a changing regulatory landscape Despite the potential opportunities, the CFTC’s decision leaves questions about how securely trust companies can establish a long-term role in derivatives settlement. The agency issued a no-action letter rather than formally amending its regulations. The letter states that CFTC staff will not recommend enforcement action against clearinghouses using trust companies for daily settlements if specified conditions are met. Unlike a formal rule amendment, which generally requires a public notice-and-comment process, staff no-action relief does not change the underlying regulation and can be withdrawn. “A change in Commission leadership could withdraw the CFTC Letter. More formal Commission action, such as amending the regulation, would be necessary to avoid this potential risk,” Jordan Yeagley, a shareholder at Buchanan Ingersoll & Rooney, told Cointelegraph. The uncertainty comes at a politically significant moment for the agency. CFTC Chair Michael Selig remains the regulator’s sole commissioner, despite a statutory structure providing for five commissioners. Selig has led the agency since December 2025, leaving four seats vacant as the regulator expands its work on digital asset markets. The political environment is also changing following the Nov. 3 US midterm elections, in which Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress. The incoming Congress, which takes office in January, will have greater power to scrutinize the CFTC’s regulatory agenda. The Senate also has a role in confirming nominees to fill the agency’s vacant commissioner seats, while the House and Senate Agriculture Committees oversee the regulator. Sen. Sherrod Brown, who won Ohio’s Senate race on Nov. 3 despite more than $60 million in opposition spending from crypto-backed political action committees, could take on a prominent role on the Senate Agriculture Committee. Coinbase’s national trust bank charter also took effect on Nov. 6, allowing Coinbase National Trust Company, a separate entity from Coinbase Custody Trust, to provide federally supervised digital asset custody services. Several major crypto firms have also secured US national trust bank approvals over the past months, including Circle, Ripple, Crypto.com and Stripe-owned Bridge. The charters, granted by the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC), reflect the industry’s expansion into federally regulated financial services. Traditional banks contest crypto firms’ expanding role The expansion of specialized trust companies has prompted objections from traditional banking groups. In October, the Independent Community Bankers of America sued the OCC, arguing that its national trust bank charter rules could allow crypto firms to conduct certain banklike activities without meeting all the requirements imposed on conventional banks. The lawsuit reflects a broader disagreement over how specialized financial institutions should be regulated as they expand into services also provided by banks. Cody Carbone, CEO of The Digital Chamber, told Cointelegraph that the CFTC’s relief does not put trust companies in a better or worse position than traditional banks. Trust companies and banks already compete for services permitted under their respective charters, Carbone said, adding that the decision gives clearinghouses more options without preventing banks from retaining their business. “A trust company charter is not a regulatory shortcut,” he said. Revocable relief faces a changing regulatory landscape Despite the potential opportunities, the CFTC’s decision leaves questions about how securely trust companies can establish a long-term role in derivatives settlement. The agency issued a no-action letter rather than formally amending its regulations. The letter states that CFTC staff will not recommend enforcement action against clearinghouses using trust companies for daily settlements if specified conditions are met. Unlike a formal rule amendment, which generally requires a public notice-and-comment process, staff no-action relief does not change the underlying regulation and can be withdrawn. “A change in Commission leadership could withdraw the CFTC Letter. More formal Commission action, such as amending the regulation, would be necessary to avoid this potential risk,” Jordan Yeagley, a shareholder at Buchanan Ingersoll & Rooney, told Cointelegraph. The uncertainty comes at a politically significant moment for the agency. CFTC Chair Michael Selig remains the regulator’s sole commissioner, despite a statutory structure providing for five commissioners. Selig has led the agency since December 2025, leaving four seats vacant as the regulator expands its work on digital asset markets. The political environment is also changing following the Nov. 3 US midterm elections, in which Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress. The incoming Congress, which takes office in January, will have greater power to scrutinize the CFTC’s regulatory agenda. The Senate also has a role in confirming nominees to fill the agency’s vacant commissioner seats, while the House and Senate Agriculture Committees oversee the regulator. Sen. Sherrod Brown, who won Ohio’s Senate race on Nov. 3 despite more than $60 million in opposition spending from crypto-backed political action committees, could take on a prominent role on the Senate Agriculture Committee. Magazine: What Democrats’ US midterm sweep means for the CLARITY Act

news.articleText: Across Protocol warns users to avoid app amid reports of drained wallets The protocol is investigating a potential security incident affecting its domain, while several users have reported losing funds after interacting with the platform. Crosschain bridging protocol Across, which allows users to transfer digital assets between Ethereum and other blockchain networks, warned users Tuesday not to access its app or connect their wallets while it investigates a potential security incident. In a Tuesday X post, Across advised users against signing transactions or approvals until further notice, without specifying the nature of the incident or whether its website had been compromised. Source: Across Protocol On X, one user claimed to have lost $9,000 in USDC, while another reported losing 7,053 USDT0 across seven transactions on the Plasma blockchain. A third user said their wallet was drained after using the bridge several times, alleging that the website had been compromised. Across asked the users for transaction details to investigate their reports. Cointelegraph has not independently verified the reports. Across Protocol did not immediately respond to Cointelegraph’s request for more details. Across Protocol responds to user reporting $9,000 USDC loss. Source: X user bilm01 NEAR AI discloses separate security breach In a separate security incident, NEAR AI disclosed Monday that attackers exploited a vulnerability in its AI infrastructure, exposing account details belonging to approximately 100 users and data from 18 AI agents. According to a Nov. 9 incident report, attackers exploited a remote code execution vulnerability in SGLang, an open-source AI inference engine, to gain access to an internal server and other infrastructure. The compromised data included user names, email addresses, agent chat histories, settings and logs, while two customers had API keys exposed. NEAR AI said attackers may also have observed requests processed on the compromised server, including those running in confidential mode. The company said it had patched the vulnerability, revoked exposed credentials and restored access to its cloud services. news.title: Ava Labs exec says NYSE deal marks end of blockchain’s ‘general purpose era’
news.summary: Ava Labs’ John Nahas said the collaboration with the NYSE shows institutions moving past pilots toward purpose-built onchain market infrastructure.

news.titleTr: Ava Labs exec says NYSE deal marks end of blockchain’s ‘general purpose era’
news.summaryTr: Ava Labs’ John Nahas said the collaboration with the NYSE shows institutions moving past pilots toward purpose-built onchain market infrastructure.
news.articleText: Ava Labs exec says NYSE deal marks end of blockchain’s ‘general purpose era’ Ava Labs’ John Nahas said the collaboration with the NYSE shows institutions moving past pilots toward purpose-built onchain market infrastructure. Traditional finance is moving past one-size-fits-all blockchains, according to John Nahas, chief business officer at Ava Labs, the company behind the Avalanche network. Nahas told Cointelegraph that the planned NYSE-affiliated tokenized securities platform, which will use Avalanche technology for clearing and settlement, illustrates that financial institutions want more control over how their blockchains operate. “Capital markets need reliable performance and predictable cost settlement, certainty and control over the network and its participants,” he said. “It’s really important for this chain to be purpose built for the needs of NYSE.” Nahas argued that the crypto industry’s preference for general-purpose blockchains and its reluctance to adapt to the compliance rules financial institutions face have slowed adoption. “Crypto always wants to put the crypto part front and center,” Nahas said. He sees a shift toward blockchains designed for specific use cases. “I look at this as the end of the general purpose era,” he said. Related: Avalanche’s AVAX leads crypto gains following NYSE tokenization deal Adjusting to institutional needs The NYSE move, announced on Monday, comes as more companies object to third parties tokenizing their shares for trading on OKXICE, a separate venue proposed by crypto exchange OKX and NYSE parent Intercontinental Exchange (ICE). OKXICE listed 67 companies that had objected as of Nov. 5, including Apple, Amazon, Meta and Tesla. Nahas put the pushback down partly to a lack of understanding among incumbents, who he said see crypto as a speculative “wild west.” He said a “wholesale change” to market infrastructure built around institutions’ needs would make the potential efficiency gains clearer and expected objecting companies would “come around.” Dennis Lee, the NYSE’s head of digital issuance, said the exchange will be “picking the right technology for each job,” as its develops the platform. Although the NYSE-affiliated platform will support equities issued on a variety of blockchains, the settlement ledger had to allow the exchange to “control who can take part and keep costs predictable,” both elements Lee said Avalanche met. On public blockchains, such as Ethereum, institutions can restrict access to their own applications, while the underlying networks remain open. Congestion can also drive up transaction fees. The NYSE spent a year testing Avalanche, giving Ava Labs time to tailor its approach to the exchange’s needs, Nahas said. “The problem is general purpose chains don’t want to or most of the time cannot adapt to the existing frameworks,” he said. Resilience to changing landscape Nahas said the ability to adapt matters most when regulations are still taking shape. “Nobody wants to be on the wrong side of a line that didn’t exist the day before,” he said. In his view, building around the rules financial institutions already follow can help projects move forward while regulators clarify how those rules apply to crypto. Asked what the “blue wave” in the House and Senate could mean for the US crypto industry, Nahas said he remained optimistic. “The landscape has changed, but the underlying fact is that this train has left the station,” he said. “You see that today in a big way.” Magazine: What Democrats’ US midterm sweep means for the CLARITY Act

news.titleTr: Kimber Digital Securities gains broker-dealer status for tokenized assets
news.summaryTr: The Plume affiliate plans to offer tokenized US stocks, ETFs and bonds through self-custodial wallets, with traditional shareholder rights preserved.
news.articleText: Kimber Digital Securities gains broker-dealer status for tokenized assets The Plume affiliate plans to offer tokenized US stocks, ETFs and bonds through self-custodial wallets, with traditional shareholder rights preserved. Kimber Digital Securities, an affiliate of blockchain network Plume, said Tuesday it had registered as a broker-dealer with the US Securities and Exchange Commission and joined the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority. In its announcement, the company said it plans to offer tokenized US stocks, exchange-traded funds (ETFs) and bonds that investors could hold in self-custodial wallets. The company gave no launch date. Tokenized stocks are digital tokens that represent company shares or rights tied to those shares. Transfers of the tokens are recorded on a blockchain. The rights investors receive depend on how the tokens are structured. Unlike wrapped securities, the proposed tokens would represent existing ownership rights recorded through the Depository Trust Company (DTC). The company said investors would retain their dividend and voting rights and could transfer eligible holdings between traditional brokerage accounts and onchain wallets. The company also plans to offer yield-bearing investment products to stablecoin users, including tokenized shares in funds managed by major US asset managers. Tokenized stock market surges sixfold as exchanges prepare for 24/7 trading Kimber’s registration comes as other companies prepare to launch around-the-clock trading of tokenized US securities. On Monday, Formation Securities announced plans for a Solana-based trading venue offering tokenized shares of Galaxy Digital, Exodus Movement and Forward Industries, with a launch targeted for early 2027. Major US exchange operators are pursuing similar initiatives ahead of 2027. The New York Stock Exchange is developing a 24/7 tokenized securities platform using Avalanche for settlement, while Nasdaq is targeting the second quarter of 2027 for its tokenized equity initiative with Kraken’s parent, Payward. The value of tokenized stocks onchain has surged more than sixfold over the past year, rising to $3.87 billion from $643.3 million in November 2025. Tokenized stocks. news.title: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
news.articleText: Release Number 9324-26 CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers November 09, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced eight orders filing and settling charges against Michael Talento, Anthony Tyler Williams, Quillan Roberto Black, Christopher Williams, Michael Levi Peters, Jordan Taylor Morgan, Lewis Matthew Neal, and Tyler Evan MacKechnie for acting as unregistered associated persons of unregistered foreign introducing brokers. According to the orders, the introducing brokers engaged in the solicitation of orders for off-exchange leveraged or margined retail foreign currency and retail commodities transactions with U.S. customers who were not eligible contract participants. The respondents solicited those customers without registering as associated persons of the introducing brokers, as required. Under the orders, the respondents must cease and desist from engaging in their illegal conduct. They also are barred for two years from registering with the Commission in any capacity or acting as a principal, agent, or employee of any CFTC registrant. Each order also recognizes the penalty the respondent owes in a related Securities and Exchange Commission proceeding. These orders relate to a prior Commission order sanctioning Netrios LP Ltd. and Red Acre Ltd. for facilitating illegal off-exchange commodity transactions with U.S. customers. [See CFTC Press Release No. 9263-26] The SEC has filed and settled charges against the respondents based on the same underlying conduct. The CFTC thanks the SEC for its assistance. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
news.articleText: Release Number 9323-26 CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today issued an interpretation (“Interpretation”) of the requirement that designated contract markets (“DCMs”) provide competitive, open, fair, and impartial access to their members and persons with trading privileges under Commission Regulation 38.151(b) (“Impartial Access Requirements”). “Derivatives markets must operate on a uniform basis at a national scale in order to achieve the purposes set out in the Commodity Exchange Act,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Geographic access restrictions are inconsistent with those purposes and the Act’s impartial access requirements.” DCMs must cease domestic geographic restrictions that violate the Impartial Access Requirements within 30 days, or else submit to the Division of Market Oversight (“Division”) an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. Further, within 30 days, DCMs should ensure that intermediaries accessing their markets are not impeding and are complying with the DCM’s Impartial Access Requirements, or else submit to the Division an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. The Commission will consider the facts and circumstances of any particular case in connection with potential Commission action. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
news.articleText: Release Number 9321-26 CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets November 04, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the U.S. Department of Agriculture today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to safeguard the integrity of U.S. agricultural markets. The MOU will allow the CFTC and USDA to harmonize policies and practices to better share information and increase access to risk management tools. The agreement will also assist both agencies with monitoring and identifying structural or potential systematic risks, among other things. “For decades, America’s agricultural community has relied on our markets to hedge risk, manage uncertainty, and plan for the future,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “I’m proud that the CFTC and USDA have formalized this partnership through an MOU that will strengthen protections for America’s farmers, ranchers, and producers while expanding opportunities to manage risk through more efficient data sharing. I commend Secretary Rollins for her partnership and commitment to a more coordinated regulatory approach that safeguards the integrity of our markets and ensures they continue serving the agricultural community that feeds and clothes our nation.” “Faster and more transparent data sharing between USDA and CFTC is critical to helping our farmers and ranchers navigate an ever-changing market,” said USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins. “This MOU builds upon USDA’s ongoing data modernization efforts and allows our agencies to collaboratively identify risks and improve responses to market events. Breaking down barriers between government agencies to deliver for our customers is a hallmark of this administration and I am looking forward to the successes this MOU will bring.” -CFTC-

news.articleText: Release Number 9320-26 CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas entered a default judgment against defendants Walter Dunning Larrick III and Cambridge Financial Advisors LLC for their participation in a commodities fraud scheme. In entering the default judgment, the court found the defendants fraudulently solicited and misappropriated more than $3 million from participants. The court found the defendants falsely represented they would use participant funds to trade futures and options, including those involving natural gas, oil, and gold; made material misrepresentations and omissions about the profitability of commodity trading with them; and issued false account statements to conceal their misconduct. The court further found the defendants misappropriated participant funds by making payments to existing participants in a manner akin to a Ponzi scheme, paying Larrick’s personal expenses, and sending funds to offshore accounts in Costa Rica. The court ordered the defendants to pay a $9,767,625 civil monetary penalty and $3,255,875 in restitution. It also permanently enjoined them from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission regulations, as charged, and imposed permanent trading and registration bans. The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2023 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 8768-23.] -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
news.articleText: Release Number 9319-26 CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig today released a statement announcing that perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities can begin trading for the first time on designated contract markets that are dually registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission as notice-registered national securities exchanges to trade security futures products. Key excerpts from Chairman Selig’s statement: “Today, perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities (the ‘Equity Perps’) can begin trading for the first time on CFTC-registered exchanges. … “This expansion marks a significant step towards allowing U.S. market participants, consistent with applicable law, to avail themselves of the advantages of perpetual futures that have led to their emergence as widely sought tools for risk-management and price-discovery. I believe that bringing these types of innovative products into our regulated markets ensures that American investors and traders can access these products within the protections of the CFTC’s proven regulatory framework, rather than being forced to turn to offshore, and often unregulated, venues. … “The Equity Perps build on the foundation of the [Commodity Futures Modernization Act of 2000] and the [CFTC-SEC Memorandum of Understanding]. For too long, regulatory uncertainty left innovative products, such as security futures and equity perpetual futures, stranded in what SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins has aptly described as a regulatory ‘no man’s land’ due to a lack of harmonization between the agencies. The CFTC and SEC have turned the page on that era, and are committed to delivering regulatory clarity for innovative products and a clear path to market, rather than more casualties of jurisdictional disputes.” Read Chairman Selig’s full statement here. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
news.articleText: Release Number 9318-26 CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading October 28, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced it will host an industry roundtable Dec. 15 to discuss issues related to the viability of derivatives markets moving to 24/7 trading. The dialogue will build upon the CFTC’s Request for Comment earlier this summer on 24/7 trading. The CFTC’s roundtable will provide a public venue for dialogue on the evolving market structures shaping derivatives markets, including overnight trading, tokenization, infrastructure and staffing needs, and operational readiness. Participants will convene from across the industry to discuss how the Commission can promote responsible innovation while protecting market participants and preserving the integrity and resilience of U.S. derivatives markets. “I have been consistently clear: under my leadership, the CFTC will not take a one‑size‑fits‑all approach to 24/7 trading. Market structure evolves best through thoughtful and responsible progress, and that’s exactly why we’re hosting a roundtable to hear directly from industry on their views for 24/7 trading across different asset classes,” Chairman Selig said. The roundtable will take place at CFTC’s headquarters in Washington. Information regarding the agenda, speakers, and registration will be posted at a later date. This event will be open to the public and livestreamed on CFTC.gov. Please note the number of in-person participants may be limited, and visitors will be subject to security checks. Members of the public are welcome to submit speaker nominations to [email protected]. -CFTC-

news.title: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
news.articleText: Release Number 9317-26 ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — Last week, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the Risk Management Center at Kansas State University co-hosted the 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon) in Overland Park, Kansas. The two-day conference brought together industry leaders, policymakers, and market participants to examine critical issues facing the agricultural economy, developments in derivatives markets, and the risk management tools American farmers, ranchers, and agribusinesses depend on. Conference Highlights CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig joined K-State President Richard Linton to welcome participants on opening day. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig addressed conference attendees, “I have spent a lot of time this year traveling around the country and talking to farmers and ranchers working hard each day to provide the food, feed, and fiber we depend on throughout our country and the world. I’ve met with farmers, ranchers, agribusinesses, and energy producers in Iowa, Texas, Nebraska, South Carolina, and Florida, and now, I’m with all of you here in Kansas.” [Watch Chairman Selig’s full remarks here.] Following Chairman Selig’s remarks, panelists examined the relationship between cash and derivatives markets, evolving commodity contracts, and the importance of effective hedging tools for agricultural producers. There were also panels where industry representatives addressed access to agricultural credit and the financial challenges facing producers and merchants. Additional afternoon discussions focused on rising production costs, fluctuating commodity prices, supply chain disruptions, and broader pressures on the farm economy. In addition, conference participants engaged in discussions about emerging market developments, including perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral, and their implications for agricultural risk management. CFTC Chief Advisor Alex Titus and White House Council of Economic Advisers Member Aaron Hedlund also examined the U.S. economic outlook, agricultural trade, and policies shaping American agriculture. The first day concluded with a keynote address from U.S. Department of Agriculture Deputy Secretary Stephen Vaden. U.S. Senator Roger Marshall of Kansas opened the second day with a morning keynote address on agricultural policy and legislative priorities facing American producers. The morning continued with discussions on agricultural prediction markets, the use of data in modern commodity markets, and developments in event contracts. In addition, panelists examined superintelligence, information advantages, and market integrity, including the implications of emerging technologies for market participants and regulators. Chairman Selig joined Futures Industry Association President and CEO Walt Lukken for a fireside chat examining the Commission’s priorities, the evolving regulatory landscape, and developments shaping derivatives markets. The conference concluded with discussions on enhancing public understanding of markets through data and customer education, followed by a panel examining clearing, market access, and the role of intermediaries in derivatives markets. Chairman Selig delivered closing remarks, concluding AgCon2026. -CFTC-

items.articleText: Borsa İstanbul CANLI: VIOP güne yükselişle başladı - VİOP BIST 30 endeksine dayalı Aralık vadeli kontratı, bugün açılış seansında önceki normal seans kapanışının yüzde 0,17 üzerinde 15.265,00 puandan işlem gördü. Borsa İstanbul Vadeli İşlem ve Opsiyon Piyasası'nda (VİOP) BIST 30 endeksine dayalı aralık vadeli kontrat güne yüzde 0,17 yükselişle 15.265,00 puandan başladı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Dün satış ağırlıklı seyreden aralık vadeli endeks kontratı, normal seansı yüzde 0,09 azalışla 15.239,00 puandan tamamlamıştı. Endeks kontratı akşam seansında da düşüşünü sürdürerek 15.230,00 puandan işlem gördü. Küresel piyasalar, teknoloji şirketlerine ilişkin iyimserliğe karşın ABD'de beklentilerin üzerinde gelen enflasyon verisinin ABD Merkez Bankasının (Fed) gelecek ay faiz artıracağı yönündeki beklentileri güçlendirmesiyle karışık seyrediyor. Analistler, bugün yurt içinde perakende satışların, yurt dışında ise Almanya'da enflasyon ve Avrupa Merkez Bankası (ECB) Başkanı Christine Lagarde'ın konuşmasının takip edileceğini belirterek, teknik açıdan endeks kontratında 15.400 ve 15.500 puanın direnç, 15.100 ve 15.000 puanın destek konumunda olduğunu kaydetti.

items.articleText: Borsada bilanço sezonu tamamlandı: İşte piyasa değeri en yüksek şirketler Borsa İstanbul'da bilanço sezonunun tamamlanmasıyla şirketlerin piyasa değerlerine ilişkin sıralama da netleşti. Finans ve sanayi sektörlerinden şirketlerin yer aldığı listede zirvedeki isimler dikkat çekiyor. Borsa İstanbul'da bilanço sezonunun tamamlanmasıyla birlikte, piyasa değeri en yüksek olan ilk on şirketin son çeyrek net kârları, özsermayeleri ve toplam piyasa değerleri netleşti. Listenin onuncu sırasında yer alan Akbank T.A.Ş. ise 368.940.000.000 TL piyasa değeri açıkladı. Bankanın son dört çeyrek net kârı 64.309.061.000 TL, özsermayesi ise 330.258.000.000 TL seviyesinde gerçekleşti. Dokuzuncu sırada bulunan Türk Hava Yolları Anonim Ortaklığı, 427.800.000.000 TL piyasa değerine ulaştı. Havacılık şirketinin son dört çeyrek net kârı 114.474.000.000 TL, özsermayesi ise 1.135.117.000.000 TL olarak kayıtlara geçti. Bilanço döneminin kapanışıyla netleşen verilerde sekizinci sırada BİM Birleşik Mağazalar A.Ş. yer aldı. Şirketin piyasa değeri 457.800.000.000 TL, son dört çeyrek net kârı 30.185.375.000 TL ve özsermayesi 221.686.578.000 TL oldu. Enka İnşaat ve Sanayi A.Ş. ise 483.600.000.000 TL piyasa değeriyle yedinci sırada kendine yer buldu. Şirket, son dört çeyrekte 31.775.030.000 TL net kâr açıklarken, özsermayesi 431.784.851.000 TL olarak gerçekleşti. Koç Holding A.Ş., 538.624.745.820 TL piyasa değeriyle altıncı sırada yer aldı. Holdingin son dört çeyrek net kârı 59.757.000.000 TL, özsermayesi ise 851.790.000.000 TL olarak hesaplandı. Beşinci sırada yer alan Enpara Bank A.Ş., 560.140.521.810 TL piyasa değerine, 8.023.937.000 TL son dört çeyrek net kârına ve 25.109.000.000 TL özsermayeye sahip. Sıralamada dördüncü sırada yer alan Türkiye Petrol Rafinerileri A.Ş., 640.177.837.436 TL piyasa değerine sahip bulunuyor. Şirketin son dört çeyrek net kârı 122.513.085.000 TL ve özsermayesi 522.888.885.000 TL oldu. Türkiye Garanti Bankası Anonim Şirketi ise 643.020.000.000 TL piyasa değeri ile üçüncü sırada yer aldı. Türkiye Garanti Bankası Anonim Şirketi'nin son dört çeyrek net kârı 123.755.633.000 TL, özsermayesi ise 520.116.000.000 TL oldu. Listenin ikinci sırasında bulunan QNB Bank A.Ş., 812.350.000.000 TL piyasa değeri ile dikkat çekti. Bankanın son dört çeyrek net kârı 57.506.783.000 TL seviyesinde gerçekleşirken, özsermaye büyüklüğü 213.283.000.000 TL oldu. Açıklanan finansal verilere göre, piyasa değeri sıralamasında ilk sırada yer alan Aselsan Elektronik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş., 1.540.140.000.000 TL piyasa değerine ulaştı. Şirketin son dört çeyrek net kârı 41.305.565.000 TL, özsermayesi ise 334.974.960.000 TL olarak kayıtlara geçti.

items.summaryTr: Nvidia Yönetim Kurulu, CEO Jensen Huang'ın yabancı bir istihbarat operasyonunun hedefi olup olmadığını araştırmak üzere bağımsız soruşturma başlattı. Soruşturmanın Huang'ın görevine ilişkin belirsizlik yaratmasıyla şirket hisseleri iki işlem gününde yaklaşık yüzde 10 geriledi.
items.articleText: Nvidia hisselerinde 1,8 trilyon dolarlık değer kaybı! Gözler CEO Huang'da Nvidia Yönetim Kurulu, CEO Jensen Huang'ın yabancı bir istihbarat operasyonunun hedefi olup olmadığını araştırmak üzere bağımsız soruşturma başlattı. Soruşturmanın Huang'ın görevine ilişkin belirsizlik yaratmasıyla şirket hisseleri iki işlem gününde yaklaşık yüzde 10 geriledi. Yapay zeka çipi üreticisi devi Nvidia, CEO Jensen Huang'ın Çin istihbaratıyla bağlantılı olduğundan şüphelenilen bir kadınla ilişki yaşadığını açıklamasının ardından şirket yönetiminin başlattığı soruşturmayla sarsıldı. Huang'ın görevine devam edip etmeyeceğine ilişkin belirsizlikler Nvidia hisselerinde iki günde yaklaşık yüzde 10 kayba yol açarken, şirketin piyasa değeri ekim ayındaki zirvesinden bu yana yaklaşık 1,8 trilyon dolar geriledi. CNBC ve ABD'li kaynakların haberine göre, Nvidia Yönetim Kurulu, Huang'ın yabancı bir istihbarat operasyonunun hedefi olup olmadığını ve şirket sırları ile ABD ulusal güvenliğinin tehlikeye girip girmediğini araştırmak üzere bağımsız bir soruşturma başlattı. Soruşturmayı yürütmek için Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz hukuk bürosu ile daha önce New York Güney Bölgesi Başsavcı Vekili olarak görev yapan Joon H. Kim görevlendirildi. Huang e-posta ile özür diledi Huang, pazar günü çalışanlarına gönderdiği e-postada evlilik dışı ilişki yaşadığını kabul ederek ailesinden ve çalışanlarından özür diledi. Ancak mesajında ilişki yaşadığı kişinin kimliğini açıklamadı. Financial Times'ın haberine göre Huang, Nvidia müşterilerinden Singapur merkezli Megaspeed'in eski yöneticisi Alice Huang ile ilişki yaşadı. ABD istihbarat kurumlarının söz konusu kadının Çin istihbaratıyla bağlantılı olduğundan ve Pekin'e bilgi aktardığından şüphelendiği bildirildi. Nvidia Yönetim Kurulu ise mevcut aşamada şirket sırlarının veya ABD ulusal güvenliğinin tehlikeye girdiğine inanmak için herhangi bir gerekçe bulunmadığını açıkladı. Huang, açıklamalarının ardından pazartesi günü California'daki Nvidia merkezine giderek üst düzey yöneticilerle olağan toplantısını gerçekleştirdi. CNBC'ye konuşan kaynaklara göre toplantının başında özür dileyen Huang, soru almadı ve kısa süre içinde şirketin iş gündemine geçti. Salı günü de toplantılarını sürdürdü. Şirket içindeki atmosferi "üzüntülü" olarak tanımlayan çalışanlar, Huang'ın günlük faaliyetleri sürdürerek işlerin normal seyrinde olduğu mesajını vermeye çalıştığını belirtti. Nvidia'nın piyasa değerinden 1,8 trilyon dolar silindi Soruşturmanın Huang'ın görevden ayrılmasıyla sonuçlanabileceğine ilişkin endişeler, Nvidia hisselerinde sert satışlara neden oldu. Hisseler pazartesi günü yüzde 4'ün, salı günü ise yüzde 6'nın üzerinde değer kaybetti. İki günlük toplam düşüş yaklaşık yüzde 10'a ulaşırken, Nvidia S&P 500 endeksinin bu dönemde en kötü performans gösteren ikinci hissesi oldu. Şirket hisseleri 6 Ekim'de gördüğü zirveden bu yana yüzde 29 gerileyerek 30 Mart'tan bu yana en düşük seviyelerine yaklaştı. Nvidia'nın piyasa değeri yaklaşık bir ay önceki 5,8 trilyon dolardan 4 trilyon dolar civarına indi. Hisseler ayrıca 2012'den bu yana ilk kez üst üste altıncı haftalık düşüşünü kaydetmeye yöneldi. Wall Street'te Huang'ın ayrılma ihtimali tartışılıyor Seaport Global Securities analisti Jay Goldberg, Huang'ın şirketten ayrılmasının Nvidia hisseleri için ağır sonuçlar doğurabileceğini belirtti. Goldberg, "O giderse yükseliş senaryosu da onunla birlikte gider" değerlendirmesinde bulunarak, Huang olmadan Nvidia'nın geleceğini öngörmenin son derece güç olduğunu söyledi. Aprio Wealth Management Yatırım Direktörü Simeon Wallis ise Nvidia üzerindeki baskının soruşturmadan önce başladığına dikkat çekti. Wallis, yapay zeka altyapı yatırımlarının maliyetlerine ilişkin endişelerin ABD ara seçimlerinin ardından arttığını, yönetim kurulu soruşturmasının ise belirsizlikleri derinleştirdiğini belirtti. Nvidia'nın değerlemesi 2013'ten bu yana görülen en düşük seviyede Hisse fiyatındaki sert düşüş, Nvidia'nın piyasa değerleme göstergelerini de önemli ölçüde aşağı çekti. 5 Kasım 200,13 dolar olan Nvidia'nın hisse fiyatı dün yaşanan yüsde 5,47 düşüşle birlikte 168,89 dolar seviyesine indi. Şirketin hisseleri, gelecek 12 aya ilişkin beklenen karının 12 katından daha düşük bir çarpanla işlem görerek 2013'ten bu yana en düşük seviyesine indi. Nvidia'nın S&P 500'e göre göreli değerlemesi 2002'den bu yana en düşük seviyeye gerilerken, fiyat/kazanç oranının kar büyümesine bölünmesiyle hesaplanan PEG oranı 0,162 ile tarihi dip seviyesine ulaştı. Bununla birlikte Wall Street analistlerinin büyük bölümü şirket hakkındaki olumlu beklentilerini koruyor. ABD'li haber kaynaklarına göre takip ettiği 82 analistin 78'i Nvidia için "al" tavsiyesi verirken, ortalama 320 dolarlık hedef fiyat, hissede gelecek 12 ayda %90'ın üzerinde yükseliş beklentisine işaret ediyor. Gözler 17 Kasım'daki bilançoda Nvidia'nın 17 Kasım'da açıklayacağı üçüncü çeyrek finansal sonuçları, yatırımcıların gündemindeki bir diğer önemli başlık olacak. Analistler, şirketin hem üçüncü çeyrekte hem de 31 Ocak'ta sona erecek mali yılın tamamında gelir ve net karının %90'ın üzerinde artmasını bekliyor. Nvidia'nın 2027 ve 2028 mali yıllarına ilişkin analist tahminleri şimdilik korunurken, bilanço sonrasında güncellemeler yapılması bekleniyor. Öte yandan Alphabet, Meta ve Amazon'un yapay zeka yatırımlarına yönelik sermaye harcamalarındaki artış da Nvidia'nın büyüme görünümüne ilişkin tartışmaların merkezinde bulunuyor. Bloomberg'in derlediği tedarik zinciri verilerine göre bu üç şirket, Nvidia'nın gelirlerinin yaklaşık %23'ünü oluşturuyor. Futurum Group CEO'su Daniel Newman, soruşturmanın Huang hakkında ilave bir usulsüzlük ortaya koymadan sonuçlanması durumunda hisselerde toparlanma yaşanabileceğini belirtirken, mevcut belirsizliklerin yatırımcıların kısa vadede temkinli kalmasına neden olabileceğini ifade etti. Nvidia ise Huang'ın CEO görevini kesintisiz biçimde sürdürmeye kararlı olduğunu açıkladı.

items.title: ABD'nin İran'a saldırısında sürpriz gelişme: İki haftalık kritik süre
items.summary: Katar'ın diplomatik girişimleriyle ABD'nin İran'a yönelik olası askeri saldırısını en az iki hafta erteletecek süre sağlandığı öne sürüldü. Washington ile Tahran arasındaki kritik anlaşmazlıklar sürerken, gözler yeni bir çatışmayı önlemeye yönelik müzakerelere çevrildi.

items.articleText: ABD'nin İran'a saldırısında sürpriz gelişme: İki haftalık kritik süre - Katar'ın diplomatik girişimleriyle ABD'nin İran'a yönelik olası askeri saldırısını en az iki hafta erteletecek süre sağlandığı öne sürüldü. Washington ile Tahran arasındaki kritik anlaşmazlıklar sürerken, gözler yeni bir çatışmayı önlemeye yönelik müzakerelere çevrildi. İsrail merkezli i24NEWS ve The Jerusalem Post'un diplomatik kaynaklara dayandırdığı haberlere göre, Katar Başbakanı ve Dışişleri Bakanı Şeyh Muhammed bin Abdurrahman Al Sani, Paris'teki temaslarında ABD'nin olası saldırısını önlemek için en az iki haftalık diplomatik süre sağlandığını aktardı. Trump ile Beyaz Saray'da görüştü CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Katar Başbakanı Al Sani, salı günü Beyaz Saray'da ABD Başkanı Donald Trump ve Başkan Yardımcısı JD Vance ile görüştü. Ardından Paris'e geçen Al Sani, G7 ülkelerinin dışişleri bakanları ve Suudi Arabistanlı mevkidaşıyla diplomatik temaslarda bulundu. Trump ise görüşmenin ardından İran ile çatışmaların sona erdirilmesine yönelik çabalarda ilerleme kaydedildiğini açıkladı. İran'ın askeri açıdan yenilgiye uğratıldığını savunan ABD Başkanı, yeni saldırı seçeneğini ise gündemden çıkarmadı. Üç kritik konuda anlaşmazlık sürüyor Diplomatik girişimlere rağmen ABD ile İran arasında önemli görüş ayrılıkları bulunuyor. Müzakerelerde özellikle İran'a uygulanan deniz ablukasının kaldırılması, nükleer faaliyetlerin geleceği ve dondurulan İran varlıklarının serbest bırakılması konuları öne çıkıyor. Tarafların olası bir anlaşmanın hangi adımlarla ve nasıl bir takvimle uygulanacağı konusunda da uzlaşamadığı belirtiliyor. Katar Dışişleri Bakanlığı, görüşmelerde ilerleme sağlandığını duyururken, arabuluculuk çalışmalarının devam ettiğini bildirdi. Elde edildiği belirtilen iki haftalık sürenin, Washington ile Tahran arasındaki anlaşmazlıkların giderilmesi ve çatışmaların yeniden başlamasının önlenmesi için kullanılması hedefleniyor. Ancak taraflar arasında henüz nihai bir anlaşmaya varılmış değil.

Trump ile Beyaz Saray'da görüştü CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Katar Başbakanı Al Sani, salı günü Beyaz Saray'da ABD Başkanı Donald Trump ve Başkan Yardımcısı JD Vance ile görüştü. Ardından Paris'e geçen Al Sani, G7 ülkelerinin dışişleri bakanları ve Suudi Arabistanlı mevkidaşıyla diplomatik temaslarda bulundu. Trump ise görüşmenin ardından İran ile çatışmaların sona erdirilmesine yönelik çabalarda ilerleme kaydedildiğini açıkladı. İran'ın askeri açıdan yenilgiye uğratıldığını savunan ABD Başkanı, yeni saldırı seçeneğini ise gündemden çıkarmadı. Üç kritik konuda anlaşmazlık sürüyor Diplomatik girişimlere rağmen ABD ile İran arasında önemli görüş ayrılıkları bulunuyor. Müzakerelerde özellikle İran'a uygulanan deniz ablukasının kaldırılması, nükleer faaliyetlerin geleceği ve dondurulan İran varlıklarının serbest bırakılması konuları öne çıkıyor. Tarafların olası bir anlaşmanın hangi adımlarla ve nasıl bir takvimle uygulanacağı konusunda da uzlaşamadığı belirtiliyor. Katar Dışişleri Bakanlığı, görüşmelerde ilerleme sağlandığını duyururken, arabuluculuk çalışmalarının devam ettiğini bildirdi. Elde edildiği belirtilen iki haftalık sürenin, Washington ile Tahran arasındaki anlaşmazlıkların giderilmesi ve çatışmaların yeniden başlamasının önlenmesi için kullanılması hedefleniyor. Ancak taraflar arasında henüz nihai bir anlaşmaya varılmış değil.

items.articleText: Electricity bills to rise by 2.5% from March - Published Electricity bills will go up by 2.5% in Jersey from March 2027, it has been announced. Jersey Electricity said the tariff increase would add just over £1 per week for a typical all-electric home from March 2027. The annual rate of inflation in Jersey rose to 3% in September, according to the latest figures. Chief executive Chris Ambler said: "We know that any increase in household costs is unwelcome, so we have worked hard to keep this rise below the island's current rate of inflation. " Ambler said: "We have again delayed the increase until March, which means it will not affect customers during the colder winter months when electricity consumption is generally at its highest." The company said it was investing £120m in the network to better its resilience and future-proof its systems. It said it continued to focus on managing costs responsibly and driving efficiencies across the business. Follow BBC Jersey on X, external, Facebook, external and Instagram, external. items.summaryTr: Sermaye piyasalarındaki işlemlere ilişkin fon soruşturmasında gözaltına alınan 7 şüpheliden eski Takasbank Genel Müdürü Yunus Arıncı, Ömer Murat Gülkan ve Ali Paslı tutuklandı. Diğer 4 şüpheli hakkında adli kontrol kararı verildi.
items.articleText: Fon soruşturmasında 3 isim tutuklandı: Eski Takasbank Genel Müdürü de listede - Sermaye piyasalarındaki işlemlere ilişkin fon soruşturmasında gözaltına alınan 7 şüpheliden eski Takasbank Genel Müdürü Yunus Arıncı, Ömer Murat Gülkan ve Ali Paslı tutuklandı. Diğer 4 şüpheli hakkında adli kontrol kararı verildi. Sermaye piyasalarında gerçekleştirilen işlemlere ilişkin yürütülen fon soruşturması devam ediyor. Soruşturma kapsamında gözaltına alınan 7 şüpheliden 3'ü tutuklandı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığınca, sermaye piyasalarında gerçekleştirilen işlemlere ilişkin fon soruşturması devam ediyor. Soruşturma kapsamında gözaltına alınıp adliyeye sevk edilen OMG Capital Advisors Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Ömer Murat Gülkan, eski Takasbank Genel Müdürü Yunus Arıncı, Bulls Yatırım Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Kemal Akkaya, Ruzy Madencilik Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Nureddin Çevik, Lydia Holding Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Enver Çevik ile Adil Katılım Bankası ortaklarından Ali Paslı ve Maygold Otomotiv Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Ayhan Yazkan'ın sulh ceza hakimliğindeki sorguları tamamlandı. Hakimlik, şüpheliler Yunus Arıncı, Ali Paslı ve Ömer Murat Gülkan'ın tutuklanmasına karar verdi. Diğer şüpheliler Enver Çevik, Nureddin Çevik, Kemal Akkaya ve Ayhan Yazkan hakkında ise adli kontrol tedbiri uygulandı. Tutuklu sayısı 123'e çıktı 9 Kasım'da Adalet Bakanı Akın Gürlek, İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığınca yürütülen fon soruşturmalarına ilişkin, "9 Kasım 2026 itibarıyla, soruşturma kapsamında 464 şüpheli bulunmaktadır. 120 kişi tutuklu olup 262 kişi hakkında adli kontrol tedbiri uygulanmıştır." açıklamalarında bulunmuştu. Bugün tutuklandığı açıklanan 3 isimle birlikte toplam tutuklu sayısı 123'e çıktı.

Fed yetkililerinin şahin açıklamaları ve beklentileri aşan ABD enflasyon verileri, Aralık ayında faiz artırımı beklentilerini güçlendirerek değerli metal üzerindeki satış baskısını artırdı.
items.articleText: Gümüşte yatırımcılar dipten alım yaptı: ABD enflasyonu sonrası kayıplar telafi edildi Gümüş, bir önceki seansta yüzde 3'ün üzerinde değer kaybetmesinin ardından rotasını yeniden yükselişe çevirdi. Fed yetkililerinin şahin açıklamaları ve beklentileri aşan ABD enflasyon verileri, Aralık ayında faiz artırımı beklentilerini güçlendirerek değerli metal üzerindeki satış baskısını artırdı. Gümüş geri döndü Gümüş, dünkü seansta ABD enflasyonunun ardından gelen yüzde 3'ün üzerindeki düşüşten sonra toparlandı. Fiyatlar yeni işlem gününde TSİ 09:13 itibarıyla gün içi aynı oranda yükselişle 53,1 dolar seviyesine geri döndü. ABD enflasyonu beklentileri aştı ABD'de manşet enflasyon Ekim ayında aylık bazda yüzde 0,4 arttı. Eylül ayında yüzde 0,6 olan oran gerilerken piyasa beklentisi yüzde 0,3 seviyesindeydi. Çekirdek enflasyon ise üçüncü ay üst üste yüzde 0,3 olarak gerçekleşti. Böylece çekirdek enflasyon da yüzde 0,2 olan beklentiyi aştı. Fed'in şahin mesajları gümüşte satışları artırdı Fed yetkililerinden gelen şahin açıklamalar ve güçlü enflasyon verileri, Aralık ayında faiz artırımı beklentilerini destekledi. Kitco News analizinde, yükselen borçlanma maliyetleri, hisse senetlerindeki zayıflık ve endüstriyel talebe yönelik endişelerin değerli metallerdeki satış baskısını artırdığı belirtildi. Gümüşte 54,64 dolar seviyesi direnç konumunda Kitco News'in teknik analizine göre, gümüşte yukarı yönlü hareketin devam etmesi için fiyatın 53,42-54,64 dolar aralığındaki direnç bölgesini aşması gerekiyor. Bu bölgenin üzerinde kalıcı hareket görülmesi halinde 55 dolar, ardından 56-57 dolar aralığı gündeme gelebilecek. Aşağı yönlü harekette 48 dolar seviyesi izleniyor Analizde teknik görünümde aşağı yönlü hareket açısından ilk hedef 51 doların altına inilmesi olarak belirlendi. Bu seviyenin aşılması halinde 50,01 dolar ve 48 dolar destekleri takip edilecek. İlk destek 51,27 dolar, ardından 51 dolar seviyesinde bulunuyor. Gümüşte kritik direnç ve destek seviyeleri Kitco News analizinde öne çıkan teknik seviyeler şöyle sıralandı: İlk direnç 53,42 dolar, ikinci direnç 54,64 dolar. Yukarı yönlü hedefler 55 dolar ve 56-57 dolar aralığında bulunuyor. Aşağı yönlü harekette ise 51,27 dolar ve 51 dolar destekleri, bu seviyelerin altında 50,01 dolar ve 48 dolar hedefleri izleniyor.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.titleTr: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summaryTr: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
items.articleText: Here’s what happened in crypto today Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation. Today in crypto, pro-crypto lawmaker Tom Emmer was elected House Republican minority whip as Democrats prepare to take control of Congress, hotter-than-expected US inflation raised concerns about a potential half-point Federal Reserve rate hike in December, and Coinbase, Kalshi and other trading firms backed the CFTC in a legal battle over perpetual futures tied to US stocks. Crypto ally Tom Emmer elected House GOP minority whip Pro-crypto US Representative Tom Emmer has been elected House Republican minority whip, securing the party’s second-highest leadership position as Democrats prepare to take control of Congress in January. Emmer beat Texas Representative August Pfluger in a 103-76 secret ballot vote, according to Politico. He previously served as House Republican majority whip and will remain the party’s No. 2 leader, this time under incoming Minority Leader Jim Jordan. As minority whip, Emmer will be responsible for rallying Republican votes, coordinating the party’s legislative strategy and helping maintain unity on key bills. “Tom has been one of the strongest advocates for digital assets in Congress, and he has led the fight against a government-controlled CBDC and stood up for American innovators,” GOP Senator Cynthia Lummis said on X. Hot US inflation raises odds of half-point Fed hike in December Crypto industry experts warned on Tuesday that higher-than-expected US inflation could lead to a another Federal Reserve interest rate hike, making borrowing more expensive and potentially discouraging investment in cryptocurrencies. The US Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 0.4% month over month in October, above economists’ forecast of 0.3%, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics - a slower increase than September’s 0.6% rise. Core inflation, which excludes food and energy prices, rose 0.3%, above the expected 0.2%. Currently, the Federal Reserve holds its benchmark interest rate at 3.75% to 4.00%, after raising it by a quarter-point in September and leaving it unchanged in October. The report came just a few hours after Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said in London that another core inflation reading of 0.3% or higher could prompt the Fed to consider a larger interest rate hike in December. “In that case, I believe a 50-basis-point hike in the policy rate should be considered at the December meeting,” Waller said. “Hiking only 25-basis-points would put our credibility at risk, a risk I am not eager to take.” Coinbase, Kalshi join lawsuit backing CFTC over US stock perp futures Coinbase, Kalshi and four other companies asked a federal court Monday to accept a brief backing the United States Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) in a lawsuit over perpetual futures tied to individual US stocks. According to a proposed amicus brief shared Monday by Coinbase legal representative Molly Abraham, the group also includes Kraken parent Payward, trading companies DRW Holdings and Jump Trading, and crypto investment company Paradigm Operations. The companies argue that stock perpetual futures fall under existing US futures laws. The filing comes days after a federal judge found that the CFTC likely “exceeded its statutory authority” in allowing single-stock perpetuals to trade as security futures. The case could determine whether US exchanges can offer retail traders contracts that track individual stocks without expiring. On Nov. 3, the CFTC announced that single-stock perpetual futures, or stock perps, could begin trading on US-regulated exchanges for the first time. The Capital Markets Alliance Association (CMAA), a newly formed trade and advocacy group representing traditional financial market participants and whose members include Cboe and Citadel Securities, sued the CFTC last week, challenging the CFTC’s authority to allow the contracts to trade.

items.titleTr: Initia confirms second exploit in 3 weeks, $3.27M stolen in latest attack

items.articleText: Initia confirms second exploit in 3 weeks, $3.27M stolen in latest attack Initia said an attacker exploited compromised cloud credentials to move $3.27 million in crypto assets, with about $2.16 million remaining frozen on its halted network. Layer-1 blockchain network Initia confirmed Wednesday that it has suffered its second security exploit in less than three weeks, with an attacker stealing about $3.27 million in crypto assets after compromising the platform’s cloud infrastructure. On Wednesday, Initia said the attacker gained unauthorized access on Monday through a command injection attack involving a compromised Google Cloud Platform key. The company said the breach exposed environment variables, allowing the attacker to access Initia’s GitHub and cloud accounts and obtain additional credentials. According to Initia, the attacker accessed Anvil, a platform hosting rollups, and validated fraudulent Inter-Blockchain Communication (IBC) withdrawals from five rollups, releasing assets held in the network’s escrow accounts. Initia said about $2.16 million of the stolen assets remain frozen on its halted network. The attacker sold assets on Initia’s decentralized exchange and withdrew 13,400 TIA, 8,000 USDC.inj and 597,000 Noble USDC. No INIT tokens were withdrawn. Initia halted its layer-1 on Tuesday and said it intends to restore the backing of affected assets. The blockchain said recovery efforts are ongoing with its law enforcement and security partners. The incident follows an Oct. 23 exploit that saw an attacker drain about $2.7 million after exploiting a vulnerability in Initia’s MoveVM script cache. This allowed malicious code to bypass security checks and create unbacked token balances that were subsequently bridged out of the network. Related: North Korean hackers create memecoins to launder funds from Binance hack: Elliptic
